Monsoon Brings Devastation to India and Beyond

Heavy rainfall and flash floods have caused widespread destruction in several states, including Jammu and Kashmir, Arunachal Pradesh, and others. The monsoon season has brought severe weather conditions, leading to landslides and flooding. The Indian government has issued a double alert for some areas, warning of potential flash floods and landslides.
